record.paper_title: Graph Partitions: Recent Progresses and Some Open Problems
record.original_question: Let k be an integer at least 2. If G is a (k - 1)-connected graph with m edges and n vertices, must G admit a k-partition (V1, V2, ..., Vk) whose size, meaning the number of edges with endpoints in different parts, is at least ((k - 1)/k)m + ((k - 1)/(2k))n + O(1)?

evidence.quote: A k-partition of V (G) is a family V1, V2, ··· , Vk of pairwise disjoint nonempty subsets with union V (G).
we usually call e(V1, V2, ··· , Vk) the size of the partition.

Bollob´as and Scott[14] (see also [58]) also conjectured that if G is (k − 1)-connected and has m edges and n vertices, then G admits a k-partition of size at least k−1
k m + k−12k n + O(1).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let k ≥ 2 be an integer. For a graph G with vertex set V(G), a k-partition of V(G) is an ordered family (V_1, V_2, …, V_k) of pairwise disjoint nonempty subsets whose union is V(G); its size is the number of edges of G having endpoints in two different parts. A graph G is (k−1)-connected if it has at least k vertices and remains connected after the removal of any k−2 of them.

Prove or disprove: there exists a constant C = C(k) such that every (k−1)-connected graph G with n vertices and m edges admits a k-partition (V_1, …, V_k) whose size is at least
   ((k−1)/k) · m + ((k−1)/(2k)) · n − C.
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is a conjecture of Bollobás and Scott on connected k-partitions. Surveys and follow-up works on judicious/max k-cut partitions (e.g., the Bollobás–Scott program, the Ma–Yen paper "On several partition problems of Bollobás and Scott", and "Better Bounds for k-Partitions of Graphs") list this connectivity-strengthened lower bound as a still-standing conjecture, with related partial results proved in special cases (e.g., k = 2 corresponds to known Edwards-type bounds for connected graphs), but no general resolution for arbitrary k ≥ 3 has been located.

status_evidence.title: On several partition problems of Bollobás and Scott (Ma–Yen)
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses several partition conjectures of Bollobás and Scott, including bounds for k-partitions of (k−1)-connected graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work treats the Bollobás–Scott connected k-partition conjecture but leaves the general case open.

status_evidence.title: Better Bounds for k-Partitions of Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Improved lower bounds on the size of k-partitions of graphs, motivated by Bollobás–Scott conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Connected k-partition lower bounds of the form ((k−1)/k)m + ((k−1)/(2k))n + O(1) are studied as open conjectures.

status_evidence.title: Problems and results on judicious partitions (Bollobás–Scott)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing conjectures on partitions of (k−1)-connected graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Bollobás and Scott explicitly conjectured the bound for (k−1)-connected graphs.
